title: Fold a Paper 42 Times and You'll Reach the Moon
description: The math of exponential doubling: why folding an ordinary sheet of paper just 42 times would make a stack taller than the distance to the Moon.
narration_lines: Take a piece of paper. Fold it in half. Now fold it again. If you could fold it forty-two times... how tall would it get?
Each fold doubles the thickness. It barely feels like anything is happening.
But by fold ten, your stack is already taller than a person.
By fold twenty-seven, it's taller than Mount Everest.
By fold thirty-two, it's already higher than the space station.
And by the forty-second fold... your paper is taller than the distance to the Moon.
That's the power of doubling: forty-two small folds, and you've left the Earth behind.
